title: Liquid Pressure Lab
objectives: Show liquids press in all directions
Link liquid pressure to dams and straws

stages.title: The Flooded Chamber
stages.narration: Shard 5 is sunk in water. Dive smart, Deep Diver — the deeper you go, the harder it pushes!

steps.text: The Baron floods a chamber to hide shard 5.
Arjun: 'The water pushes harder near the bottom!'
Newton Bot loads your diving gear.

stages.title: True or False: Liquid Pressure
stages.prompt: Decide whether each statement is true or false.

tasks.label: Pressure increases as you go deeper
tasks.explain: More liquid above means more pressure.

tasks.label: Dams are thicker at the bottom
tasks.explain: Because pressure is greatest deep down.

tasks.label: Pressure is the same at every depth
tasks.explain: Pressure changes with depth — deeper is higher.

stages.title: Liquid Pressure Around Us
stages.prompt: Tap each place to see liquid pressure at work. Visit them all!

locations.label: Dam
locations.info: Built thick at the base to hold back the greatest water pressure deep down.

locations.label: Deep-Sea Diver
locations.info: Wears a strong suit because water pressure is huge far below the surface.

locations.label: Water Tower
locations.info: Height of stored water gives pressure to push water out of taps below.

locations.label: Straw
locations.info: Lowering pressure inside lets outside pressure push the drink up.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Reach the Sunken Shard
stages.prompt: Score 80% to dive to shard 5 and bring it up!

questions.q: Dams are thicker at the base because…
options: pressure is greatest at the bottom
questions.explain: Greatest water pressure is deep down.

questions.q: A drink rises up a straw because…
options: outside pressure pushes it into the low-pressure straw
questions.explain: Pressure difference pushes the liquid up.

questions.q: At the same depth, liquid pressure is…
questions.explain: Same depth = same pressure in every direction.

stages.title: Momentum Shard 5 Charged!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Deep Diver badge
You surfaced with the shard held high!
